```{=html}
<pre class="pseudocode" data-line-number="true">
\begin{algorithmic}
\State \Call{Push}{$S,s$}; mark \(s\) discovered
\While{$S\ne\emptyset$}\State $u\gets$\Call{Pop}{$S$}
\ForAll{\(v\in Adj[u]\) in reverse order}\If{\(v\) undiscovered}\State mark and \Call{Push}{$S,v$}\EndIf\EndFor\EndWhile
\end{algorithmic}
</pre>
```
